What is paint waste costing your bodyshop?

Paint usage is useful only when it is compared with the work completed. Establish a repeatable baseline before attributing a difference to a paint system or a spray gun.

Read the guide Insights / Equipment

When should a spray gun be serviced?

Use the manufacturer’s current instructions for the exact equipment. A web article cannot prescribe a service interval for every gun, coating and working environment.

Read the guide Insights / Automotive

Where does manufacturer evidence fit in a repair?

Manufacturer and repairer programmes have their own requirements. Keeping records during the repair is usually more practical than reconstructing them at the end.

Read the guide Insights / Cybersecurity

What should a security review tell you?

Security assessments differ in scope and depth. Start with the business question and the environment, then agree the permitted work in writing with the system owner.

Read the guide Insights / Data

How do several systems become one useful report?

A dashboard can look consistent while its underlying definitions disagree. Decide what each measure means before connecting accounting, CRM, workshop and other systems.

Read the guide Insights / Finance

Where can invoice automation reduce administration?

Map how an invoice arrives, who checks it and how it reaches the financial system. The slowest part may be an exception or an unclear approval responsibility.

Read the guide Insights / Business

How do workshop capacity and profitability connect?

Job count alone does not explain workshop performance. Compare labour, repair mix, materials, delays and contribution to understand where capacity creates value.

01

4240 air-fed visor

The manufacturer describes a compressed-air-fed face shield with a belt-mounted regulator and audible low-flow warning. It requires suitable breathing-quality air and the complete approved configuration.

  • Read the current manual for the exact model
  • Confirm applicable certification and local requirements with a competent adviser
  • Plan user training, checks, maintenance and replacement items
02

Choose protection for the actual task

Filtering masks, air-fed equipment and paint-room coveralls serve different purposes. They are not interchangeable.

  • Filtering respirators are not suitable for spraying isocyanate paints
  • Discuss MP300 and particulate-mask options only for assessed suitable tasks
  • Do not treat paint-room workwear as chemical-protective clothing without the applicable approval
03

Include the air supply and maintenance

Equipment selection must consider the whole working environment.

  • 4240 is not self-contained breathing apparatus or an escape device
  • A regulator filter does not make contaminated compressor air safe to breathe
  • Confirm breathing-air testing, compatible hoses and servicing
  • Agree booth controls, training and the site-specific safe working procedure
Scope & availability
